summary: Design critical data element controls, manage remediation and specify audit-ready dashboards. Explore this hands-on enterprise data quality course.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who define, monitor, investigate or report data-quality controls across operational and enterprise data flows.
modules: ISO 8000 Audit Evidence and Action Plans
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational data, reporting processes or information management is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet-based profiling exercises.
